While actual portfolio UPB runoff decreased in the third quarter versus the second quarter, the increase of $10.9 million in realization of cash flows versus the second quarter is due to an increase in model projected runoff resulting from the recalibration of our prepayment model to incorporate actual prepayment experience in the first half of 2026.
